log2 CPM matrix of targeting sgRNAs

Source: R/qc.R
qc_log2cpm.Rd

Normalizes counts of targeting sgRNAs (controls removed) to counts per million and log2-transforms them, log2(CPM + 1).

Usage

qc_log2cpm(counts, sample_ids, ctrl_pattern = "NEG_CTRL")

Arguments

counts

Count matrix: data frame with columns sgRNA, Gene and one column of raw counts per sample (see section 'Count matrix').

sample_ids

Sample columns of counts to include.

ctrl_pattern

Regular expression matched against the Gene column to identify control sgRNAs (default is "NEG_CTRL", which matches the controls of all libraries shipped with crisprFlow).

Value

A numeric matrix with one row per targeting sgRNA (row names are sgRNA IDs) and one column per sample.

Examples

m <- qc_log2cpm(exampleCounts, exampleSampleMeta$sample_id)
m[1:3, 1:4]
#>         Plasmid     T0_1     T0_2     T0_3
#> AAK1_1 9.213399 8.991235 9.304064 9.049755
#> AAK1_2 9.610267 9.377150 9.449108 9.789926
#> AAK1_3 9.194238 8.373576 8.612652 8.930320
